Filtering on pickup_year/pickup_month (the partition columns) instead of pickup_datetime populates the Scan node's PartitionFilters clause and removes the row-level Filter node present in the baseline plan: only the pickup_year=2024/pickup_month=1 partition is read, versus all partitions being listed and scanned in the baseline.

Forcing a shuffle-hash join (SHUFFLE_HASH hint) requires an Exchange (hash repartitioning by join key) on both taxi_trips and taxi_zones before the join. The default plan (no hint) instead broadcasts taxi_zones via a BroadcastExchange and avoids shuffling taxi_trips entirely, since taxi_zones (265 rows) is well under the default auto-broadcast threshold.

Extracting the shared borough_hour CTE into a cached DataFrame and reading both downstream queries from it replaces the Scan parquet / Filter / HashAggregate chain over integrated_taxi_trips with an InMemoryTableScan in each downstream query's plan; the shared aggregation is computed once instead of once per query.
